SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF WESTBROOK, COUNTY OF MARION

ARROYO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC.,
                Plaintiff,
        v.                              Case No. CV-2024-12044
RIVERTON HOSPITALITY GROUP, LLC,
                Defendant.

COMPLAINT FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT, ACCOUNT STATED,
AND QUANTUM MERUIT

Plaintiff ARROYO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC. ("Arroyo"), by counsel, alleges:

PARTIES AND JURISDICTION
1. Plaintiff is a Westbrook corporation with its principal place of business in Marion County.
2. Defendant RIVERTON HOSPITALITY GROUP, LLC ("Riverton") is a Delaware limited liability company doing business in Westbrook.

FACTS
3. On February 12, 2023, the parties executed a written General Contractor Agreement (the "Agreement") under which Arroyo agreed to act as general contractor for the renovation of the Riverton Hotel at 88 Waterfront Drive, Marion County.
4. The Agreement provided for a Guaranteed Maximum Price ("GMP") of $4,820,000, with progress payments due within 30 days of each approved monthly application for payment (the "AFP").
5. Arroyo performed all work required under AFPs 1 through 8, totaling $3,914,500. Riverton paid AFPs 1 through 5 in full and on time. AFPs 6, 7, and 8 — totaling $1,247,300 — remain unpaid as of the filing of this Complaint.
6. On October 4, 2023, Riverton's Director of Development, Sarah Vance, emailed Arroyo's project manager, Luis Arroyo, stating: "We will resolve the outstanding AFPs by November 1. Please continue with Phase 3." (See Ex. C.)
7. On November 14, 2023, Riverton's CFO, Patrick Olen, sent a letter alleging — for the first time — that Arroyo's work on AFP 6 was "deficient" and that no further payments would be made until Phase 3 was complete. (See Ex. D.)
8. Arroyo completed Phase 3 on December 22, 2023, and submitted AFP 9 ($487,000). Riverton has not paid AFP 9 and has not paid the previously withheld AFPs 6–8.
9. Total outstanding: $1,734,300.

CLAIMS
Count I — Breach of Contract: $1,734,300 plus prejudgment interest.
Count II — Account Stated: $1,734,300.
Count III — Quantum Meruit (alternative).

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff demands judgment as above.

Dated: March 4, 2024
                                /s/ M. Caldera, Esq.
